name: Allegion
description: Allegion makes door locks, exit devices, door closers, automatic entrance doors, electronic access control and workforce-time software for commercial, institutional and residential buildings, under Schlage, LCN, Von Duprin, CISA, Interflex, STANLEY Access Technologies and others. Most sales go through distribution channels, with recurring revenue from service and software (Stanley Access inspection and repair contracts, SaaS access and workforce tools). It runs two segments: Allegion Americas (79 percent of revenue, 27.9 percent margin) and Allegion International. It keeps buying niche security makers (ELATEC in July 2025 for about $386M; Door Components, Inc. in March 2026).

employees.note: Approximately 13,300 employees worldwide, about 45 percent in the US.

businessLines.name: Allegion Americas
businessLines.how: Sells locks, exit devices, door closers, electronic access control and automatic entrance systems, mostly through distributors and dealers to institutional and commercial customers (education, healthcare, government) plus residential; also Stanley Access service contracts and SaaS.

businessLines.name: Allegion International
businessLines.how: Same security-product model outside the Americas under CISA, Bricard, AXA, Interflex, SimonsVoss, ELATEC and other brands; sold through distribution and installers.

brands.name: Schlage, LCN, Falcon
brands.note: Lock and door-control brands named in the 10-K; revenue by brand not disclosed

brands.name: CISA, Bricard, AXA, Gainsborough, Briton, SimonsVoss, ELATEC, Interflex
brands.note: Brands named in the 10-K (mostly International); revenue by brand not disclosed

brands.name: STANLEY Access Technologies
brands.note: Automatic entrance doors plus inspection, maintenance and repair services in the US and Canada

brands.name: ELATEC
brands.note: German security and access technology maker, acquired 100% on 2025-07-01 for EUR 327.9M (about $386.5M).

brands.name: Door Components, Inc. (DCI)
brands.note: US maker of custom hollow metal doors and frames, acquired 2026-03-02; price not read.
